title: DA from the GCA G Cloud 14 FW for the Digital Support Service for Unpaid Carers
description:

title: DA from the GCA G Cloud 14 FW for the Unit 4 Business World on Cloud Migration contract
description:
Xentrall Finance is progressing with the migration of the hosted Unit4 Business World (Agresso) ERP system to a cloud-based (SaaS) environment. This system underpins the financial operations of Darlington Borough Council, Stockton-on-Tees Borough Council and Tees Valley Combined Authority, making the migration a critical programme of work.

As outlined in the approved Statement of Work, the migration involves a number of technical and operational activities including system upgrade, data transfer, and structured testing and deployment phases.

Unit4 places reliance on a partner led approach, meaning there is limited direct engagement between Unit4 and Xentrall during the migration. As such, the Statement of Work confirms that project management, coordination and escalation routes will be channelled through a partner organisation.

To support this, G7 Business Solutions have been identified as the appropriate partner. G7 are an established Unit4 migration partner with responsibility under the Statement of Work to:
- Provide project management and technical coordination across all phases (plan, transform, deploy)
- Act as the primary liaison between Xentrall and the Unit4 project team
- Support the review and approval process for system customisations and integrations
- Assist with migration planning, testing, and go-live readiness

This role is critical in ensuring the migration is delivered in a controlled and efficient manner, with clear governance, defined escalation routes, and alignment to Unit4's technical requirements.

title: DA from the Digital Workplace Solutions 2 SBS10510 FW for the Microsoft CSP License and Subscriptions contract
description:
Microsoft licences are proprietary products governed by standard commercial terms established by Microsoft. Although several authorised licensing partners are available, these suppliers do not offer alternative products and possess limited flexibility regarding pricing or licence conditions. Consequently, conducting a competitive tender would not result in substantial market competition or enhanced value for money. Proceeding with the proposed direct award ensures service continuity, mitigates operational risk, and utilises existing licensing and support arrangements.
This contract covers multiple licences and services, including academic alternative licences (A5) for eligible users, network bridging between our data centre and Microsoft Azure for Teams Telephony and call centre integration, and security measures such as Azure Firewall. Additionally, the security provision encompasses the antivirus solution for all our servers. It also includes costs for a Microsoft Fabric instance used with Power BI for analytics. Essentially, CSP is a subscription to Microsoft services. 
This procurement was carried out on behalf of Stockton-on-Tees Borough Council and Darlington Borough Council.

title: Provision of Alcohol and Tobacco Research and Evaluation
description:
On behalf of Fresh and Balance, County Durham and Darlington NHS Foundation Trust have a requirement for the Research and Evaluation of Alcohol and Tobacco usage in the North East of England. The region has some of the highest rates of harm linked to both, and understanding the patterns is essential for designing interventions that work. The region consistently reports some of the highest rates of alcohol-related hospital admissions and deaths in England. Understanding who is drinking, how much, and why helps target support where it's most needed. Research will provide insight to target campaigns and evaluation of what is working.
Fresh and Balance has over 30 years' experience driving programmes of work and supporting colleagues across both local authorities and the NHS. The core strategic aim is to work at population level for a societal shift around tobacco and alcohol use.
This contract was awarded to Bluegrass Limited following a further competition via Crown Commercial Service framework RM6126-Research & insights Dynamic Purchasing System Agreement.
